name: Niwaka Ane
source:
Kenji still loves Yuki, his childhood friend. One rainy day, he meets Ayumi, who resembles a girl he met before, and she starts living at his house. Ruki, his another childhood friend, also joins them and their battle for Kenji breaks out...

[From ErogeShop]
